test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The volume of a solid cylinder is 5852 cm³ and its height is 38 cm. What is the total surface area of the solid cylinder? (Round your answer to the nearest integer) 

(Use pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume (V) = πr²h ⇒ 5852 = (22/7) × r² × 38

r² = (5852 × 7) ÷ (22 × 38) = 49 ⇒ r = 7 cm

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r) = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (38 + 7)

TSA = 44 × 45 = 1980 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1980 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Volume** of cylinder (V) = 5852 cm³

**Height** of cylinder (h) = 38 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume (V) = πr²h

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faa1528e8fc93a37562b6fa50650a35b2d8650d74acb743e2b563ddc0bd4d09a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 5852 = (22/7) × r² × 38

⇒ r² = (5852 × 7) ÷ (22 × 38)

⇒ r² = 40964 ÷ 836 = 49

⇒ r = √49 = 7 cm

⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (38 + 7)

⇒ TSA = 44 × 45

⇒ TSA = 1980 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1980 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Cylinder

The area of the curved part only is given by CSA = 2πrh.

Volume of a Hollow Cylinder

If R is external radius and r is internal radius, Volume = π(R² − r²)h.

Base Area of Cylinder

The area of the circular base or top is Area = πr².</p
